parts.title: My brother the champion
parts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer for each question.
parts.passage:
My older brother, Marek, is a professional gamer. When he told our parents that he wanted to play games for a living, they were not happy at all. My father said that it was a hobby, not a job, and my mother worried that he would never go out.

But Marek was serious. He practised for six hours every day after school, and he studied videos of the best players to learn their tricks. At sixteen, he joined a small team, and they travelled to a tournament in Berlin. They lost in the first round, and he cried all the way home.

He did not give up, though. A year later, his team won a national competition and received a prize of five thousand euros. Now my parents come to his matches and cheer louder than anyone.

I play too, but only for fun. Marek says that being a champion is hard work. He has to eat well, sleep eight hours and do exercise every morning, because it helps him think quickly. I think that the most important lesson he has taught me is that you must work hard to be good at anything.

They were delighted at the idea

questions.explanation: They were not happy at all.

questions.explanation: He studied videos of the best players to learn their tricks.

options: His team won a prize of five thousand euros
His team won the first round

His team lost in the first round
questions.explanation: They lost in the first round and he cried all the way home.

options: They ask him to choose another job

They give him money for trips
questions.explanation: They come to his matches and cheer louder than anyone.

parts.title: A short history of video games
parts.instructions: Choose the sentence that fits each gap. There are three extra sentences.
parts.passage:
The first video games were very simple. In 1972, a game called Pong appeared in bars and shops. [1] Two players hit a small white ball across the screen with two white lines, and that was all.

During the 1980s, games moved into people's homes. [2] Families bought small machines that they could connect to the television and play in the living room.

In the 1990s, the pictures became much better. [3] Characters had more colours and movements, and some games had a story with music.

In the 2000s, the internet changed everything. [4] Players could now compete with friends or with people from the other side of the world.

Today, gaming is a huge industry, and millions of people play on their phones. [5] Some of them even earn their living by playing in competitions.
sentences: Others work in offices where they design new games.
This made the games feel more like a real film.
Connecting to a game online was suddenly possible.
The first home computers were sold in the 1970s.
It was very easy to learn, but hard to stop playing.
This is why the first machines were so expensive.
Soon, the number of players grew every year.
Many of the early games were invented by students.

gaps.explanation: It was very easy to learn describes Pong, and the next sentence explains what it was like.
The number of players grew soon after games moved into homes.
Better pictures make games feel more like a real film, and the next sentence talks about characters and story.
Connecting online became possible and so players could compete far away.
Others work in offices continues from the people who play for a living.

parts.title: Playing games safely
parts.instructions: Write one word in each gap.
parts.passage: Games are fun, but it is important to play them safely. First of all, do not play for [1] long without a break. Doctors say that you should stand up and move every hour. If you play online, never tell strangers [2] real name or your address. Some people are not kind, and they may try to make you angry. If that happens, you [3] leave the game and tell an adult. Also, remember that games are made to be hard to stop. Many players say, "Just [4] more minute," and then play for an hour. It is a good idea to decide how long you will play [5] you start. Then use an alarm to help you keep [6] your plan.

gaps.explanation: Too long means longer than is healthy without a break.
Your real name: possessive adjective for the reader.
The modal gives advice about what to do if someone is unkind.
One more minute is a common phrase.
Decide how long you will play before you start.
Keep to your plan means follow it.

turns.speaker: f
turns.text: Hi, Calum, it’s Carys. About the gaming tournament on Saturday. And they told me that people who arrive at three can’t play at all, because the hall is full by then. So don’t be late. I think we should be there an hour before the doors open at two, to find a good place in the queue. See you at the station! Bring a snack, because it will be a long day.

parts.title: A talk about esports
parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and complete each note. Write one or two words, a number, a date or a time.

turns.speaker: esther
turns.text: Hello, everybody. Today, I would like to talk to you about esports, which means competitions in video games. In recent years, they have become very popular. Two years ago, about four hundred million people watched them, but last year, the number grew, and more than five hundred million people watched, which is more than the population of some continents. Some of the best players come from Asia. People often think of Japan, which makes many games, but a very famous player comes from South Korea. His fans wait for him outside the stadium. Players are usually young. Many of them start when they are sixteen, and they often retire before they are thirty, because their hands and eyes become slower. A few stay until twenty-five, but the usual age to stop is thirty. How do top players practise? Many people think they play for six hours, like a school day. But a top team practises for about ten hours a day, with short breaks. It is like a job. And they have a big team to take care of them. The team has a coach, a doctor and a cook. The driver is only for big events. The cook prepares healthy meals, because the players need energy for their brains. If you would like to become a player, how can you start? Some people join a club at school, but the first step for a real career is to join a team. You can find one on the internet. Be patient, practise a lot, and sleep well. Remember that many young players also go to school or have a part-time job, so they must organise their time carefully. Esports is not only about having fun, it is also about discipline and friendship. Thank you for listening.

gaps.explanation: Two years ago it was four hundred million; last year the number grew to more than five hundred million.

gaps.prompt: One of the most famous players is from South ___
gaps.explanation: Japan makes many games, but the famous player comes from South Korea.

gaps.prompt: Many players stop before the age of ___
gaps.explanation: A few stay until twenty-five, but many retire before they are thirty.

gaps.prompt: Anyone who wants a real career should first join a ___
gaps.explanation: A club at school is fine for fun, but the first step for a real career is to join a team.

parts.title: An interview with a game designer
parts.instructions: Listen to the interview and choose the correct answer.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Calum, you design video games. What was the first game that you made?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: I was fourteen. I’d love to say it was a pirate game, because I liked pirates, but I never finished that one, and I didn’t make a racing game either. My first finished game was very simple. A frog had to cross a busy road without being hit by cars. My friends played it at school during the break, and they asked me to make a second level. That’s when I knew what I wanted to do.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Who is in your team, and what do the writers do?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: There are about thirty of us. The artists draw the characters, and the programmers make everything work. The writers create the story. They decide who the hero is, what he wants and what stops him. Without a good story, the best graphics are boring.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What is the hardest part of your work?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: Testing. I know that talking to players and finding money are also difficult, but testing is the worst. We play the same level hundreds of times to find mistakes, and after a week, it becomes really boring. But one small bug can make people angry, so we can’t skip it.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Where do you keep your ideas?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: I don’t have a special folder at work, and I don’t write on my computer, because I forget to open the files. I keep a small notebook in my pocket. I write in it on the bus, in a café, at night. It’s full of silly drawings, and every few months a drawing becomes a game.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What do you do on a day off, and why?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: On Sundays, I play board games with my family. I’m not at the screen, and I don’t test things alone. We play for hours, and the laughter is wonderful. I want to rest my eyes, and it also reminds me that games are about people, not just computers.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What advice would you give to somebody who wants to make games?

turns.speaker: g
turns.text: Start small. Don’t buy a super expensive computer, because you don’t need it, and don’t copy ideas from other games, because it’s better to invent your own. Make a small game and finish it. A finished small game teaches you more than ten big ones that you never complete.

parts.prompt: Your school wants to organise a gaming event. Talk about the different types of activities that could be offered and decide which one would be the most popular.

parts.title: Talk about the topic
parts.instructions: Answer the questions. Try to give a reason or an example with each answer.

questions.prompt: Do you think video games are a good way to relax? Why or why not?
How can parents help children to use screens in a healthy way?
Would you like to be a professional gamer? Why or why not?
